children.role_in_glue: Provides the lower bound for the common multiplier integral; transitivity finishes the surplus inequality.

notes: Four proof components from Lemma 2.4 and Proposition 2.5. The first exports the weak Jacobian equation so the multiplier child does not repeat its analytic derivation. Parent-owned Hyperbolic, Rearrangement, Averages and PairCoefficient modules are proved helpers merged from o018 session x0044 through a948e3f; no children repackage those elementary calculations. The scalar child has no matrix/transport context; the spectral lifting has no V/pushforward hypothesis. All definitions are closed lambda applications over Mathlib/ChallengeDeps only. The parent and helpers build locally. lot check directs proposed-child stub checks to lot submit split.
